limitations: Candidate key roots derive from parameter families, not an implemented configuration parser.
Composite values require units on numeric leaves.
MVP/profile assignments are stage proposals and may be disabled/not_applicable per scenario.
Any review_required unit class must be resolved or explicitly marked not_applicable before schema freeze.
Structured-unit classes define where units are attached; they do not select clinical policy values, category coding, or fitted distributions.
